scenes.text: Your brain remembers unfinished tasks better than finished ones.
It's called the Zeigarnik effect, after psychologist Bluma Zeigarnik.
In the nineteen twenties, she noticed waiters remembered unpaid orders perfectly, then forgot them once the bill was paid.
Her experiments suggested that interrupted tasks stick in our minds.
That's why cliffhangers make you hit next episode.
Want to beat procrastination? Just start for two minutes, and your brain will want to finish.

title: Why your brain can't let go of unfinished tasks 🧠
caption: The Zeigarnik effect: we tend to remember interrupted or unfinished tasks better than completed ones. Use it to beat procrastination: just start for 2 minutes! 🧠
